summary: issue1902_fits.StoreCache._load: two workers missing the same shard both insert -> duplicate _order entries + double-counted bytes; first eviction over the 48GB cap KeyErrors and kills P4...
evidence: scripts/issue1902_fits.py:265-290: membership is checked under the first lock, the load runs outside it, and the second lock inserts UNCONDITIONALLY (self._files[relpath]=out; self._order.append; bytes += nbytes). At stage-1 start 4 workers pull sweep_B_single_f0..f3 and all miss B/ctx/single/L*.pt concurrently. Eviction loop: old=_order.pop(0); self._files[old] -> KeyError on the second occurrence of a duplicated relpath. Production cache (fp32, ~2x the ~64-70GB fp16 store) exceeds the 48GB cap -> eviction certain. Fix: under the second lock, if relpath already present, discard own load and return the existing entry; never append a duplicate _order token.
